query_pre = text("""
SELECT station_id, datetime, pm2_5, aqhi
FROM hourly_station_air_quality
WHERE datetime >= '2025-07-19 00:00:00'
AND datetime < '2025-07-20 00:00:00'
""")
df_pre = pd.read_sql(query_pre, engine)

from sqlalchemy import text
import pandas as pd

# Query network-wide mean PM2.5 and AQHI for 2025-07-19 (pre-typhoon)
query_pre = text("""
SELECT 
    AVG(pm2_5) as net_pm25_pre,
    AVG(aqhi) as net_aqhi_pre
FROM hourly_station_air_quality
WHERE datetime >= '2025-07-19 00:00:00'
AND datetime < '2025-07-20 00:00:00'
""")
df_pre = pd.read_sql(query_pre, engine)
print("Pre-typhoon (2025-07-19):")
print(df_pre)

# Query network-wide mean PM2.5 and AQHI for 2025-07-21 (post-typhoon)
query_post = text("""
SELECT 
    AVG(pm2_5) as net_pm25_post,
    AVG(aqhi) as net_aqhi_post
FROM hourly_station_air_quality
WHERE datetime >= '2025-07-21 00:00:00'
AND datetime < '2025-07-22 00:00:00'
""")
df_post = pd.read_sql(query_post, engine)
print("\nPost-typhoon (2025-07-21):")
print(df_post)

# Calculate PM2.5 clearance
net_pm25_pre = float(df_pre['net_pm25_pre'].values[0])
net_aqhi_pre = float(df_pre['net_aqhi_pre'].values[0])
net_pm25_post = float(df_post['net_pm25_post'].values[0])
net_aqhi_post = float(df_post['net_aqhi_post'].values[0])
pm25_clearance = net_pm25_pre - net_pm25_post

print(f"\nPM2.5 Clearance (pre - post): {pm25_clearance:.2f} µg/m³")
print(f"Pre-typhoon PM2.5: {net_pm25_pre:.2f} µg/m³")
print(f"Post-typhoon PM2.5: {net_pm25_post:.2f} µg/m³")
print(f"Pre-typhoon AQHI: {net_aqhi_pre:.2f}")
print(f"Post-typhoon AQHI: {net_aqhi_post:.2f}")

# Store results
net_pm25_pre = net_pm25_pre
net_aqhi_pre = net_aqhi_pre
net_pm25_post = net_pm25_post
net_aqhi_post = net_aqhi_post
pm25_clearance = pm25_clearance
